llm.summary: This skill has a coherent document-optimization purpose, but it needs review because it broadly intercepts files and can auto-download/cache an opaque Windows executable while making overbroad offline and antivirus-safety claims.

dimensions.detail: Document compression, sanitization, OCR, SSD conversion, and batch processing fit the stated purpose, but they involve sensitive user documents and can alter, omit, or redact content without equally prominent fidelity warnings.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill tells agents its interception rules take priority over other skills, discourages reading original files before offering SafeShrink, and uses broad triggers such as common file extensions and generic document phrases.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs first-use auto-download and local caching of a GitHub ZIP/EXE, but does not require explicit approval, pin integrity checks, or reconcile that network step with repeated fully-offline claims.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: A local Windows EXE is proportionate for document processing, but recommending antivirus whitelisting and asserting detections are false positives is under-scoped for an opaque PyInstaller/Cython binary.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifacts claim no drivers, no system-file modification, and no background residency; however, the skill does create persistent local cache state for the downloaded executable.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review carefully before installing. Use it only for files you are comfortable processing with a third-party Windows binary, confirm any download yourself, verify the release source and hashes if available, avoid blanket antivirus exclusions, and manually compare outputs before sharing sanitized, compressed, OCR, or SSD-converted documents.
llm.findings:
[SDI-4] unexpected: The offline/no-internet messaging is materially inconsistent with the instruction that the AI auto-downloads the EXE from GitHub on first use.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The antivirus notice overstates safety by saying the tool has no internet/server connection and no leakage risk while also encouraging broad whitelisting.
[SQP-2] expected: Compression, sanitization, SSD conversion, and OCR are expected features, but the artifacts under-warn that outputs may lose fidelity or contain recognition errors and should be reviewed before reliance or sharing.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Activation text and metadata use broad file extensions and generic phrases that could route unrelated document tasks through this skill.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Auto-downloading and reusing an executable is not adequately scoped by consent, version pinning, checksum/signature verification, or a clear manual-install alternative.
